liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Starts sloppy; a odd jam near 18 minutes reminds the reviewer of Zeppelin; Bobby goes wild at the end; Intro has precise Shine on Me harmonies, wild backing behind Pigpen, and Bobby starts slowly before letting loose [2][4][5][8][11]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Fades in out of tune, and the band plays the remainder of the song without energy [4]

## The recordings

- **gd70-04-11.sbd.cotsman.12072.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 2 songs; 31 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard with good sound for the era [4]
- **gd1970-04-11.136668.sbd.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 2 songs; 31 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1970-04-11.132470.sbd.bear.latvala.wise.flac16**: soundboard; 2 songs; 31 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer believes this was their first Dead show, on April 11 rather than the 10th, recalling Saint Stephen being played [6]
- Only a fragment of the show circulates in this source, and the reviewer wants to know why [9]
- Reviewer strongly disagrees with the earlier review that found the Lovelight flat [5]
- Reviewer ranks this among top three of about 25 shows seen, with 6-4-1970 and 8-17-1970 [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-04-11.sbd.cotsman.12072.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chuck Gannon and JCotsman; source: Soundboard (partial) [1]. Also: Partial soundboard: about 30 minutes of Lovelight and roughly two minutes of Not Fade Away; came via Chuck Gannon, seeded by JCotsman [1]
- **gd1970-04-11.136668.sbd.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Partial Show Source: sbd > Reel Master > Cassette > DAT (44k) [2]. Also: Anonymous source; a few repairs and speed adjustments were made [2]
- **gd1970-04-11.132470.sbd.bear.latvala.wise.flac16**: taped by Bear; transferred by Dick Latvala and Jim Wise; source: Partial Set 3; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-Recorded by Bear (Reel # 4 Only); 1st Generation Cassettes(TDK SA-X 100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala;… [3]
